name: calculate-paye-south-africa
description: Calculate monthly PAYE, UIF employee contribution and take-home pay for a South African salary, using the 2027-year tax table, age-based rebates and medical scheme fees tax credits.
requires_human_steps: Employer PAYE registration with SARS, monthly declarations and payment deadlines
UIF registration with the Department of Employment and Labour (separate from SARS-collected contributions)
Payroll-provider or practitioner confirmation for bonuses, allowances, fringe benefits and retirement deductions
rule_basis: 2027 individual tax table, rebates (R17,820/R9,765/R3,249) and thresholds; 2027 Medical Scheme Fees Tax Credit (R376/R752/R254 pm); UIF 1% employee + 1% employer with R17,712 pm ceiling (from 1 June 2021)
